description: Search Jump on the Trend's live AI video trends and templates by name, meme, song, scene or topic (e.g. 'locker room', 'dog bartender', 'christmas', 'couple dance'). Optional filters: category and who's in it. Returns each trend's name, what happens in it, who can star, length, price and page link. An empty query lists the current top trends.

category.description: Optional category id or name from list_categories (e.g. 'pets', 'dance', 'christmas', 'memes').

query.description: Words to look for: a trend or meme name, a song, a scene, a topic.

name: search_trends
title: Search AI video trends
